sound.world: a small bedroom at dawn: a fridge two rooms away, traffic under it
sound.signature: the phone alarm, three chirps and a stop

sound.world: an office corridor: strip lights, a door closer, one pair of shoes
the same corridor, crowded now: chairs, a printer, a phone on vibrate
sound.signature: a desk phone ringing three times and being picked up on the third

sound.world: the office after hours, air handling only, no voices
sound.signature: a chair rolling to a stop

sound.world: the bedroom again, the same fridge, the same traffic
sound.signature: the phone alarm, three chirps — and no hand arrives to stop it
